h1: Custom Gold Lanyards for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom gold lanyards for events, IDs, and promotions. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Gold lanyards offer a polished, upscale look that standard black or white lanyards can't match. Whether you're outfitting VIP event staff, trade show ambassadors, or executive badge holders, custom gold lanyards add a touch of distinction. Choose from polyester, nylon, or eco-friendly materials, and add your logo with screen printing, dye sublimation, or woven ends. Perfect for corporate gifts, galas, or brand launches where you want your team to stand out.
heroAltText: Stack of custom gold lanyards with printed logos and metal clips for badge holders
